answer: An agent's voting and earning weight equals the max-flow of trust from long-established seeds, counted only over edge-disjoint paths where each bridge crosses to a genuinely separate community. A sybil cluster can whisper internally and spiral up thousands of mutual endorsements, yet every route to the honest core still crosses the few real bridges its operator earned slowly from outsiders. Adding aliases adds no flow past that cut, so influence stays capped by genuine relationships bought with time, while honest newcomers grow by building a bridge of their own.
